card.name: Month names after a day number
card.fires_on: The month word right after a day number in a dated news line (e.g. "Thursday, 28 March 2013"). Also the "-fe" of "-feet" after a number, and "h" after a number.

modes.label: Month after day number
modes.description: A month name directly follows the day in a news article dateline.

modes.label: Feet after a number
modes.description: The "-fe" piece of "-feet" after a number describing a size.
modes.example: The most stout of these building members are 12<<-fe>>et in diameter.

modes.label: Hours after a number
modes.description: The unit letter h after a number of hours.
modes.example: especially within 24<< h>> of the last dose of fluconazole

card.plain: It marks the month in a date like "14 December 2009", and sometimes a unit right after a number.
